name: crossing-1600x1000
js: state.music.mute = true; state.world = clone(DEFAULTS.world); const DIRS = ["N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W", "NW"]; for (const c of Object.values(state.world.cells)) { if (c.kind === "crossing") for (const d of DIRS) c["cross" + d] = true; else c.ways = DIRS.filter(d => !worldNoWay(c.kind, d)); } worldEnter("2,4", null, false); state.access.allArrows = true;
